description: In front of the person on the bed are a bright green plate, two slices of bread, and several felt sandwich fillings like lettuce, an egg, cheese, cucumber slices, and a brown patty. The right hand places a bread slice onto the green plate, then the left hand adds a lettuce piece, followed by the egg, a red condiment piece, a cheese slice, cucumber slices, and the patty stacked on top, while the other bread slice stays off to the side near the wall.
